verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Stripe Treasury sits on the general Stripe API platform, with docs mentioning npm packages ('Stripe packages... check the npm registry for the latest version') and API-based objects (FinancialAccount, OutboundPayment, Transaction) that would be consumed via SDKs, plus a CLI and MCP server. However, there is no explicit documentation of official multi-language SDKs (Node, Python, Java, etc.), SDK repos, or code samples specific to Treasury. Missing for 10: explicit list/links to official Treasury SDK libraries across languages, SDK code samples, versioning/release notes for SDKs.
